messages:
samir: Heads-up — OrchidHealth private VPC: traces stopped showing up in Grafana Explore. Metrics and logs look normal. OTLP endpoint returns 200 but trace count is zero. Any quick checks I should run? pinging eng-infra.

maya: Which env? prod/qa? Can you paste promtail/grafana-agent config and last minute of promtail logs?

samir: Prod. Promtail snippet below (sanitized):

```
clients:
  - url: https://otlp.customer.orchid/v1/traces
    headers:
      Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
      # used to set tenant
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols: grpc
```

Curl to OTLP returns 200, no obvious ingest errors in AGENT logs, but grafana traces count = 0.

ben: Are we routing OTLP -> tempo inside the privVPC or directly to Grafana Cloud for this tenant? :thinking: We usually route to tempo, and tempo will drop if tenant header is wrong.

maya: +1 check the tenant header (X-Redwood-Tenant or X-Scope-OrgID depending on pipeline). If it's missing/old tempo will accept 200 but not attribute traces. Also check auth token scope.

samir: We rotated tenant creds yesterday — config might still have old header. I'll grep the config. Also, where are the customer dashboards/traces links?

maya: Dashboards: https://grafana.internal/customers/orchid/dashboards
Traces Explore: https://grafana.internal/explore?left=traces%2Fquery%3ForgId%3Dorchid

Note: there's an alert that's been noisy for Orchid: `high-p90-ingest-latency` — fires on short batch spikes. We should consider tuning to avoid flapping during the rollout.

ben: For the alert I'd suggest adding a small `for: 5m` or require min_samples (or change to increase() with min_samples=5). Also check promtail batching config — small batches can burst CPU. Example promtail batching tweak: `batch_wait: 200ms`, `batch_size: 1024`.

samir: Pushed a fix branch that updates the tenant header and bumps batch_wait: https://github.com/redwood-inference/privvpc-configs/pull/412 — can someone review? cc @maya @ben

maya: I'll review in ~1h. In the PR body include the exact log snippet showing the 401/tenant-miss and mention the rotation schedule. Also include a small rollback note.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: priv-vpc-configs/main -> staging in 15m :rocket:

ben: If staging looks good, do a canary to prod. Also please silence the `high-p90-ingest-latency` alert for Orchid for 30m during the rollout to avoid noisy pages.

samir: Will do. One more quick question — where exactly do promtail logs live? I looked under `privvpc-collector` but not sure of the path.

maya: Promtail logs are under `logs/grafana-agent/<customer>/promtail` in our object store. If you need pod logs: `kubectl -n privvpc logs deploy/promtail -l customer=orchid` (or use the console link in the dashboard).

samir: Found a 401 in promtail logs showing tenant header mismatch. Fixing and will push update to the PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
